description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 990 - Order made to declare that the Excise Duty imposed by the Excise Notification No. 989 shall not be charged on foreign liquor w.e.f. 04.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Excise Ordinance. It exercises powers vested by statute to modify excise duty regulations, specifically exempting certain imports from duty. While it names the Minister of Finance, it does so in the context of exercising statutory authority to create a regulatory change, not to announce a personnel appointment or describe ministerial portfolios. The core content is about modifying legal/regulatory requirements for excise duties.
